Grab Holdings product substitute technology threat 2026

findings.claim: 20-F 風險因素：Grab 自述競爭者含新進者與提供低價替代品者；數位支付與 ShopeePay、Google Pay、Dana、GoPay 等競爭，數位銀行主要對手為新興數位銀行。
findings.excerpt: These competitors may be well-established or new entrants and focused on providing low-cost alternatives or higher quality offerings, or any combination thereof.

findings.claim: 20-F 風險因素：AI 採用加深使第三方侵權主張風險上升，可能被迫停用某些技術。
findings.excerpt: As our business grows, competition increases and adoption of AI deepens, we face a higher risk of receiving notices claiming we have infringed upon third-party rights

findings.claim: DBS 研究報告：Grab 認為東南亞 AV 採用將緩慢、分階段，新加坡有 11 輛 AV，近期為人車混合車隊。
findings.source: DBS Group Research, Grab Holdings Ltd (2026-03-12)
findings.excerpt: from agentic AI, citing its strong driver and merchant supply network, and control over platform APIs and sees AI as an efficiency driver. Fintech breakeven is targeted for 2H26, with long-term EBITDA margins potentially reaching 30–40%, supported by lending scale and operating leverage. Autonomous vehicle deployment in early-stage, with 11 AVs in Singapore.
